mechanism: MAOIs can potentiate the sympathomimetic effects of beta-blockers and may cause hypertensive crisis; additionally, beta-blockers may mask hypoglycemia symptoms and potentiate MAOI-induced CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood pressure closely; ensure at least 14 days between MAOI discontinuation and beta-blocker initiation; educate patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms.
